intro: Been writing music since my preteens, and with AI since way before Suno — back in the OpenAI Jukebox days. AI to me is neither a tool nor a replacement but a brilliant bandmate. Most of it starts from my own humming, piano or MIDIs, so it’s “mine” in most copyright senses.

radioPage.about: You’re hearing what everyone tuned in is hearing. Every song in the catalogue plays, in random order. When the round ends — every {length} — the songs are shuffled again.
